summary: Athena Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, prepared under IFRS. The filing is a routine quarterly report with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. It contains standard disclosures on exploration properties (Excelsior Springs, Laird & Oneman, Forester) and an option agreement with Bounty Gold, but these are operational updates, not transformative events. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are identified.
